summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil-token@0.4.6 declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, unpacks the platform-specific `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the shipped `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte single-line obfuscator.io-style bundle with a shuffled string-array decoder (function `WV8StW` performing `push(shift())` rotations against a large numeric constants array) and hex-mangled identifiers; no portion of the payload is legible without runtime deobfuscation. The package advertises itself as a design-tokens library, a purpose that does not require an install-time alternate-runtime execution of an obfuscated blob. The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute code that a Node-based install-time scanner would not observe, and the obfuscation prevents inspection of what the executed payload does.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
